bot.title: Memory
bot.workspaceLink: Notes for every bot live in Settings › Memory

versions.title: Prompt versions
versions.restoreHint: Brings the prompt back to this version

settings.subtitle: Applies to every bot in this workspace
settings.notesHint: Who you are, language, currency, formats and team facts. Bots also save and update these notes when you tell them something that applies to everyone.
settings.placeholder: E.g.: I live in Portugal and use euros (€).
settings.empty: No notes yet. Bots write down here what they learn about you that applies to everyone.
settings.modeHint: When you change a bot's role or correct how it works, it updates its own prompt.

modes.autoHint: Applied right away, with an Undo card
modes.approvalHint: The bot proposes the change and you approve it in the chat

settings.howItWorks: Role and way of working live in each bot's prompt; facts and preferences live in memory. One-off requests change nothing.
